title.narrative: India - Creating the right product martket fit for the Tjebbi

description.narrative: Tjebbi, a social entrepreneur (Dutch) focusing on local impact, wants to focus on the lower (and lower middle class) women and their children/families who have to rely on public or community toilets because they are on the move or cannot afford a private toilet at home. Tjebbi developed a product for sanitary use as a portable bidet, a water dispenser working on manually driven pressure that can be held and used upside down. The device is for sanitary purposes when no clean water is available (for instance in trains).The target market is India given the size of the population with limited access to clean water. In order to prepare for full scale market introduction for which external investment financing will be needed, on site market validation is required. The overall aim of the project is to test and create the best product market fit for the Tjebbi. The market validation will be done in Pune, India, being a fast growing city. This means it represents what most urban and suburban regions in big cities also experience. With Technical Assistance Tjebbie can invest in product optimization and select optimal framework for exploration lab for market validationThe market validation is to provide necessary input for the business plan in order to seek investment finance. Tjebbi is a start-up company with limited means to bare the full costs of the market validation. Thus Technical Assistance from DGGF may help to overcome a crucial phase to convince potential co-investors and qualify for DGGF Start-up financing.
